description: Shell script for managing Docker authentication directories and files for the OpenClaw project, including functions to trim, normalize, and collect auth directories and files based on CSV input or overrides.

methods.name: openclaw_live_trim
methods.description: Trims leading and trailing whitespace from input string.

methods.name: openclaw_live_normalize_auth_dir
methods.description: Normalizes an auth directory path by trimming and ensuring it starts with a dot.

methods.name: openclaw_live_should_include_auth_dir_for_provider
methods.description: Returns the auth directory for a given provider based on its name.

methods.name: openclaw_live_should_include_auth_file_for_provider
methods.description: Returns the auth file for a given provider based on its name.

methods.name: openclaw_live_collect_auth_dirs_from_csv
methods.description: Collects auth directories from a CSV string of provider tokens.

methods.name: openclaw_live_collect_auth_dirs_from_override
methods.description: Collects auth directories based on override environment variable, supporting 'all' and 'none'.

methods.name: openclaw_live_collect_auth_dirs
methods.description: Collects auth directories, prioritizing override if set.

methods.name: openclaw_live_collect_auth_files_from_csv
methods.description: Collects auth files from a CSV string of provider tokens.

methods.name: openclaw_live_collect_auth_files_from_override
methods.description: Collects auth files based on override environment variable, supporting 'all' and 'none'.

methods.name: openclaw_live_collect_auth_files
methods.description: Collects auth files, prioritizing override if set.

methods.name: openclaw_live_join_csv
methods.description: Joins multiple values into a CSV string.
